name: Medium
summary: Publishing platform where anyone can read and write stories and articles, with a paid membership for unlimited access.
description: A home for human stories and ideas: anyone can publish without building an audience first, and readers browse stories by topic, publication or author. Free reading comes with ads and limits; Medium Member and Friend of Medium plans remove them and share part of the fee with the writers you read.
